verdict.rationale: The evidence documents retrieving raw account and transaction data (90 days via Account Aggregation, up to 24 months via Extended Transaction History), but nothing describes cleaned merchant names, transaction categorization, or merchant logos. Generic 'data-driven intelligence' and 'personalized financial guidance' marketing lines are adjacent and do not document enrichment. The axis applies to a financial data aggregation platform, so the lack of evidence makes this 'none'.

support.subject: As a developer, raw bank transactions come back enriched — cleaned merchant names, categories, and logos — documented as a capability of the platform, not left as an exercise for me
